title: Settings fully recategorized into 12 focused tabs
summary: The Settings home screen went from 6 broad tiles down to 12 focused ones, each scoped to one real thing instead of several stacked together: Appearance, Bell Schedule, Calendar Display, Categories & Rules, External Calendars, Google Calendar Sync, Keyboard Shortcuts, Backup & Sync, Portal Sync, Developer Tools, Danger Zone, and Help.

Destructive actions (Clear All Notes, Reset Classes to Default, Reset Everything) were pulled out of wherever they used to be buried and grouped into a single Danger Zone tab, clearly separated from everyday settings. Simulate Date and the password-protected Set as Site Defaults moved into Developer Tools. The two different GitHub-Gist-based sync mechanisms -- publishing a live .ics feed for Google Calendar, versus full cross-device app data sync -- got split into Google Calendar Sync and Backup & Sync respectively, since they were previously mashed into one confusing 'Google Calendar Sync' section despite doing very different things.

The Classes and Calendar gear-icon buttons now deep-link straight into the specific tab they're about (Bell Schedule, Calendar Display, Categories & Rules) instead of a broad catch-all tab. Search and the keyboard-shortcut rebinding from the last update both carried over unchanged.
